title: Pops Fernandez attends Lea Salonga’s Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony ahead of 60th concert

blocks.text: Pops Fernandez had a special reason to be in Los Angeles recently. She was invited there to witness history unfolding. Pops attended the Sept. 4 ceremony where Lea Salonga received her star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, becoming the first Filipina to receive the honor. Invited by Manila International Film Festival chair Lisa Lew, Pops got to see the historic moment up close and even had what she called her “fangirl moment” with Salonga. She shared photos and clips from the ceremony with fans, expressing her pride in seeing a fellow Filipino artist receive one of Hollywood’s most recognizable honors. Pops, however, will soon have to trade her Hollywood fangirl moment for preparations closer to home. She turns 60 this year and will mark the occasion with a concert simply titled “Pops” on Nov. 26 at the Newport Performing Arts Theater. The show will include some songs she has rarely performed in past concerts, along with a new single and special guests. “It will be a special moment not only for me but for fans as well,” she said. Echo Jham Entertainment Production is behind the concert, with Homer Flores as music director and Calvin Neria as concert director. Lea has just put her name on Hollywood Boulevard. Pops is about to celebrate another number that carries its own weight: 60. And after the fangirling in Los Angeles, she has her own celebration waiting for her back home.
